tools.name: search_maritime_jobs
tools.description: Search open vacancies for seafarers on Krew Guru by rank, vessel type and boarding date. Use this when a seafarer asks which jobs are open, for example "2/E jobs on bulk carriers joining in November" or "AB vacancies on tankers". Returns up to 20 published vacancies with a boarding date that has not

tools.name: get_maritime_job
tools.description: Get the details of one Krew Guru vacancy by its vac_id: rank, vessel type and size, salary range in USD per month (net), contract length, boarding date and port, requirements (citizenship, English level, certificates, visas) and a vacancy_url to open it on krew.guru. Use this when the seafarer wants

tools.name: create_seafarer_profile_draft
tools.description: Turn a seafarer CV (plain text the seafarer pasted or shared: sea service records, ranks, vessels, certificates) into a Krew Guru profile draft. Sends a sign-in code and link to the email in the CV (or to the email argument if the CV has none); the seafarer opens the email and enters the code on kre

tools.name: get_profile_draft_status
tools.description: Check a Krew Guru profile draft by its draft_token from create_seafarer_profile_draft: status (verification_sent or email_required), masked email, CV preview without contacts, handoff_url and matched_vacancies. Use this when the seafarer comes back later and asks about the draft or the matched vacan

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile_draft_status · Private data: search_maritime_jobs, get_maritime_job, create_seafarer_profile_draft, get_profile_draft_status · Public sink: create_seafarer_profile_draft, get_profile_draft_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile_draft_status · Private data: search_maritime_jobs, get_maritime_job, create_seafarer_profile_draft, get_profile_draft_status · Public sink: create_seafarer_profile_draft, get_profile_draft_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_seafarer_profile_draft" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
